cards.example_en: You gain confidence when you speak in front of the class.

cards.example_en: I asked my coach for guidance before the final match.

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：热（名词）

cards.example_en: Our hotel room faced the sea and smelled of salt.

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: Our journey over the mountains took two full days.
cards.example_zh: 我们翻山的旅程花了整整两天。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: We leave the classroom when the bell rings.
cards.example_zh: 铃声一响，我们就离开教室。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: Keep to the left when you cycle through the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 骑车进校门时请靠左边走。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: Let's check the map before we go.

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：仅仅的
cards.example_en: A mere five minutes was enough for us to miss the bus.
cards.example_zh: 仅仅五分钟就让我们错过了公交车。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: Cyclists mount the last hill before the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 骑车的人在校门前登上最后一座小山。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: The missing cake was a mystery until my brother confessed.

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: Write your full name clearly on the cover of the notebook.
cards.example_zh: 把你的全名清楚地写在笔记本封面上。

cards.scene: 出行交通 · Travel and Transport
cards.example_en: The windows face the north, so the room stays cool in summer.
cards.example_zh: 窗户朝向北面，所以夏天房间很凉快。
